passages.title: The school of Hellas
passages.author: Thucydides
passages.blurb: Pericles' Funeral Speech: we love beauty without extravagance and wisdom without softness; the whole city is an education for Greece.

passages.title: The second trireme
passages.author: Thucydides
passages.blurb: 427 BC: the Athenians change their minds about Mytilene and send a second trireme racing after the first.

passages.title: At the Assinarus
passages.author: Thucydides
passages.blurb: 413 BC: the Athenian army in Sicily is destroyed at the river Assinarus; few out of many came home.

passages.title: Aegospotami
passages.author: Xenophon
passages.blurb: 405 BC: Lysander catches the Athenian fleet on the beach; Conon escapes with nine ships and the Paralus sails for Athens.

passages.title: The peace of 404
passages.author: Xenophon
passages.blurb: The Spartans' terms: the Long Walls come down, the fleet is handed over; the walls are demolished to the music of flute-girls.

passages.title: The death of Theramenes
passages.author: Xenophon
passages.blurb: 404/3 BC: the Thirty drag Theramenes from the altar; he drinks the hemlock with a joke.

passages.title: Cyrus sees the King
passages.author: Xenophon
passages.blurb: Cunaxa, 401 BC: Cyrus charges his brother the King, wounds him, and is killed; his faithful Artapates dies beside him.

passages.title: The King is coming
passages.author: Xenophon
passages.blurb: Cunaxa, 401 BC: a Persian horseman gallops up shouting that the King is approaching; Cyrus and the Greeks arm in haste.
